result.reason: The clause adds a clear 30-day non-renewal deadline for one-year automatic renewals, satisfying the notice-window component of both the preferred and fallback positions. However, it includes no cap on renewal price increases, so it does not reach even the fallback position requiring increases of no more than 5%. It also omits the preferred 60-day Vendor reminder. The amendment is otherwise narrow, preserves the existing termination and breach provisions, and is professionally drafted, although granting the 30-day non-renewal right to either Party is broader than the preferred Customer opt-out formulation.
